g.text: Written to /var/home/everbox/rotector-selfbot/config.toml - only the sections you
change are rewritten, comments elsewhere are kept.
Your Discord credentials. DISCORD_TOKEN / DISCORD_BOT_TOKEN override these.
User token. Treat this like a password.
Optional bot application token, used only when no user
token is set. A bot reaches servers it was invited to and
nothing else -- no friends, no DMs -- but can list every
member of them, which a user account cannot. Needs the
SERVER MEMBERS INTENT enabled in the Developer Portal.
1 live, 1 requests, 1 friends, 2 group DM, 4 server. Select one and press 's' to scan.
